wiki.quote: I am no sorcerer's familiar. Rather, I'll take a sorcerer as my pet.

entries.name: Bane
lines: Enfeeble weakens Viper's attack damage, any healing he receives and his cast range, which makes him unable to harass enemy heroes with Nethertoxin, Poison Attack and Viper Strike.
Viper's Corrosive Skin is useless against Bane as all of his damaging abilities deal Pure damage.
Viper has no solutions to cancel Fiend's Grip and in addition, he hates buying disabling items like Eul's Scepter of Divinity.

entries.name: Broodmother
lines: Viper's lack of escape and durability means he can be ran over in a laning stage by Spawn Spiderlings.
Broodmother can bring Viper down quickly with Insatiable Hunger activated.

entries.name: Chaos Knight
lines: Viper has no response to the standard initiation combo of Reality Rift into Chaos Bolt.
Phantasm and Chaos Strike can eliminate Viper almost instantly with it's damage output.
Besides Nethertoxin, Viper has no other ways of dealing with Phantasm.

entries.name: Keeper of the Light
lines: The Keeper of the Light easily farms on the line against the Viper, due to the fact that it has a long-range Illuminate, and the Viper, in turn, cannot use its advantage of dominance on the center line, due to the fact that it does not reach the Keeper of the Light

entries.name: Invoker
lines: Ice Wall and Ghost Walk can be used to kite and escape from Viper.
Chaos Meteor and Sun Strike deal heavy damage and can quickly bring Viper down.
Cold Snap, Tornado, and Deafening Blast are powerful disables that reduce Viper's effectiveness.
E.M.P. burns Viper's limited mana pool, reducing his potential poison damage.
Forge Spirits can melt Viper's armor and reduce his durability.

entries.name: Morphling
lines: Viper has no disable, which means he has no way of preventing Morphling from escaping from any of his abilities or keep him inside Nethertoxin.

Viper is almost exclusively damage over time, which is weak against Morphling due to Attribute Shift (Strength Gain). Additionally, Morphling has no passive abilities, reducing Nethertoxin's effectiveness against him even further.

Morphling can turn into Viper himself, allowing him to use any of Viper's abilities against him (excluding Viper Strike). This is particularly bad due to the fact that Viper is already a very slow hero, making Poison Attack and Corrosive Skin's slows especially difficult to deal with.

entries.name: Lifestealer
lines: Rage ignores all of Viper's magical damage, although Viper Strike can pierce spell immunity and slows him down.
Feast and Open Wounds from Aghanim's Shard can be combined to heal through Viper's physical damage.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Infest can be used to disarm Viper, preventing him from using Poison Attack on Lifestealer's allies.

entries.name: Luna
lines: Even though Luna has a hard time laning against Viper due to Nethertoxin being able to disable Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing, Luna can take out Viper once she builds either Black King Bar or Silver Edge which will allow her to attack Viper freely.
Eclipse can often finish off Viper from early-to-mid stages of the game before he can retaliate as Corrosive Skin gives little magic resistance to him early on.
Manta Style is an item that Luna commonly buys in most of the games, which lets her disjoint Viper Strike. Additionally, illusions from Manta Style can make Viper waste time attacking them.

entries.name: Phantom Lancer
lines: Phantom Lancer can overwhelm Viper with spawned illusions from Spirit Lance and Doppelganger. In addition, Diffusal Blade, a core item on Phantom Lancer, burns Viper's limited mana pool, reducing his potential poison damage.
Viper's various slows do not work against Phantom Rush. Additionally, it is almost impossible to keep Lancer inside Nethertoxin's radius in order to disable the passive.

entries.name: Pugna
lines: Pugna's Decrepify allows him to save allies from being ganked by Viper, since Viper mostly relies on direct attacks in order to deal damage.
Nether Ward can discourage Viper from spamming his abilities.
Viper's damage over time is not enough to kill Pugna as he will have more than enough time to save himself (or his allies) with Life Drain and Viper has no solutions to cancel it.
Pugna has no passive abilities, which renders Nethertoxin nearly useless.

entries.name: Rubick
lines: If Rubick can use Spell Steal to take Nethertoxin, he will be able to disable Corrosive Skin, reducing much of Viper's durability.
He can also steal Viper Strike, which can be used to hinder a hero on your team (or multiple heroes, if Rubick has Aghanim's Scepter).

entries.name: Terrorblade
lines: Viper's damage over time and lack of disables makes him easy to Sunder.
Viper's physical damage is mitigated by Terrorblade's high armor.
Terrorblade under Metamorphosis can quickly kill Viper with heavy physical damage.

entries.name: Weaver
lines: Shukuchi ignores slows and allows Weaver to escape Viper's onslaught.
Time Lapse dispels Poison Attack and Corrosive Skin and undoes poison damage.
Weaver's high burst damage allows him to kill Viper before being killed.

entries.name: Windranger
lines: Windrun evades Poison Attack and counteracts the slow.
Viper's low mobility makes him an easy Shackleshot target.
Focus Fire grants Windranger significant physical damage output to quickly wear Viper down.
Powershot is a strong harassment and zoning tool against Viper in lane.

entries.name: Wraith King
lines: Viper's Nethertoxin cannot disable Reincarnation, which could put him in disadvantage against Wraith King if his whole team is with him.
In addition, Viper doesn't like buying Diffusal Blade, which is the only item that can help him against Wraith King.
Wraith King's high burst damage allows him to kill Viper before being killed.
Viper cannot interrupt heroes with powerful channeling abilities: Bane, Enigma, Shadow Shaman, Warlock
Heroes with a built-in haste can ignore Viper's slows: Dark Seer, Lycan
Illusion or summon-based heroes can be a problem to Viper due to his lack of AoE damage: Naga Siren, Phantom Lancer, Beastmaster
Heroes with high physical or pure burst damage can kill Viper before his damage over time sets in.
Heroes that can drain mana negatively affect Viper's ability to use Poison Attack, Nethertoxin and Viper Strike: Lion, Anti-Mage
Heroes who do not have nor rely on passive abilities make Nethertoxin much less effective: Clinkz, Pugna, Nature's Prophet, Dark Seer, Lycan, Tusk
Town Portal Scroll allows heroes to escape from Viper, as he cannot interrupt it nor kill a healthy hero before they teleport.
Black King Bar nullifies most of Viper's arsenal as most of his damage comes from his damage-over-time abilities.

Ghost Scepter can protect against Viper's attacks. And when upgraded into Ethereal Blade, it can reduce his magic resistance that Corrosive Skin provides him while also disarming him, rendering him unable to use Poison Attack and increasing cast range, which allows it's owners to fight against Viper without getting into range of Corrosive Skin.
Glimmer Cape's invisibility prevents Viper from attacking the target, and the magic resistance counteracts Viper's damage over time.

Force Staff can allow a hero to escape while slowed by Viper, or to close the gap on Viper while he is on the run. Later it can be upgraded into Hurricane Pike that can do the same while also increasing attack range, which allows it's owners to fight against Viper without getting into range of Corrosive Skin.
Silver Edge's break disables Corrosive Skin, making him weaker even against the heroes he naturally counters.
Manta Style can disjoint Viper Strike and can make Viper waste time attacking illusions.
Diffusal Blade can slow Viper with its active ability and pin him down while burning his mana.
Linken's Sphere blocks Viper Strike, and Viper has no other ways to break the Spell Block. In addition, Viper hates buying disabling items.
Lotus Orb will reflect Viper Strike back at Viper, discouraging him from using it himself. It will also dispels most of Viper's debuffs.

entries.name: Abaddon
lines: Because Poison Attack has almost no cooldown, Aphotic Shield is ineffective as a hard dispel.
Viper Strike can prevent Borrowed Time from activating passively and block Curse of Avernus.

entries.name: Axe
lines: Viper Strike prevents Counter Helix from triggering, which significantly lowers Axe's damage output in the early to mid game.
Viper's various slows and damage over time prevents Axe from initiating as well as putting his Blink Dagger on cooldown.

entries.name: Bristleback
lines: Viper Strike can disable Bristleback and prevents Warpath from building stacks. Besides losing his defensive passive, Bristleback also loses his ability to build up damage over lengthy battles.
Viper can perpetually kite Bristleback with Poison Attack and Viper Strike.

entries.name: Dragon Knight
lines: Dragon Knight is easily harassed by Poison Attack after the laning stage ends.
Corrosive Skin protects Viper from Breathe Fire and returns damage.
Viper Strike can disable Dragon Blood, Dragon's Knight main source of armor and health regeneration.
Between Poison Attack and Viper Strike, Viper can keep Dragon Knight permanently slowed even in Elder Dragon Form.

entries.name: Earthshaker
lines: Being a melee hero, Earthshaker's movement is liable to suppression by Poison Attack and Viper Strike.
Earthshaker's kit, with the exception of Enchant Totem, deals magic damage. Corrosive Skin effectively blunts his killing potential with a standard Blink combo among other things.
Viper Strike can disable Aftershock, which removes the stun and bonus damage from Enchant Totem and Echo Slam.

entries.name: Huskar
lines: Viper Strike can disable Berserker's Blood, which Huskar relies upon for attack speed and healing.
The damage from Burning Spear and Life Break is largely absorbed by Corrosive Skin. It also will return some damage, making it risky to use Burning Spears in the laning stage.
Because Huskar wants to be on low health for Berserker's Blood, he is particularly vulnerable to Poison Attack.

entries.name: Magnus
lines: Most of Magnus's abilities except Empower will trigger damage through Corrosive Skin.
Poison Attack and Viper Strike can slow Magnus during Skewer, as well as putting his Blink Dagger on cooldown, preventing him from initiating or re-initiating.

entries.name: Mars
lines: Viper Strike can disable Bulwark entirely, making Mars far less tanky. Using Nethertoxin inside Arena Of Blood may discourage enemies from following up with Mars's initiation.
Rod of Atos is currently common on Viper and keeps Mars in position long enough to be killed.
However, Viper is not very tanky earlier in the game, so positioning against Mars is important for Viper since a well-timed Spear of Mars can be the end of Viper.

entries.name: Monkey King
lines: Viper Strike prevents the buildup of Jingu Mastery stacks.
Monkey King's high base movement speed is of little worth against the array of slows Viper possesses.
All of Viper's magical damage over time stops Monkey King from using Tree Dance. It also ignores the extra armor bestowed by Wukong's Command.

entries.name: Puck
lines: Viper wins on the central line of Puck, because he has a huge damage from the Poison Attack ability, which Puck is not able to constantly avoid using Phase Shift, which will give Viper an advantage in the possible damage inflicted on each other

Puck takes more damage than it does due to the passive Corrosive Skin ability of the Viper, which makes it unprofitable for the Puck to fight against the Viper at an early stage of the game, when the Puck has a very small pool of health

entries.name: Necrophos
lines: Viper Strike prevents Heartstopper Aura from dealing damage or healing Necrophos.
Viper's magic damage is amplified whenever Ghost Shroud is used.
Corrosive Skin makes Viper tankier against Death Pulse and Reaper's Scythe.

entries.name: Nyx Assassin
lines: Corrosive Skin minimizes the damage from Impale and Mind Flare, and anything else Nyx Assassin tries to throw at Viper.

Nyx Assassin cannot survive several poison damage-over-time output from Poison Attack, Nethertoxin, Corrosive Skin and Viper Strike, not even while he has Spiked Carapace active. And to make things worse, Nyx Assassin is not a common Silver Edge wielder to counter this problem at all.

entries.name: Razor
lines: Storm Surge is counteracted by Viper Strike, leaving Razor without his extra movement speed.
Static Link's damage drain doesn't bother Viper a lot as most of his early to mid game damage is magical.

entries.name: Slark
lines: Viper Strike can disable Essence Shift and the regeneration aspect of Shadow Dance.
Dark Pact doesn't mean a lot against Viper's ubiquitous slows.
Viper becomes a relevant presence in team fights before Slark can procure his standard items (e.g. Shadow Blade).

entries.name: Spectre
lines: Viper Strike can disable Desolate and Dispersion, leaving Spectre with far less damage output and damage mitigation in engagements.
Spectre is one of the weakest heroes at early levels. Viper can stifle her farm with early fights before Spectre purchases any major items.

entries.name: Templar Assassin
lines: All of Viper's abilities quickly burn through Refraction charges.
Templar Assassin's short range, aside from Psi Blades' spill damage, makes her vulnerable to Poison Attack harassment.
Templar Assassin usually buys health and armor items for damage. Outside of Black King Bar, Viper will almost always be able to kill her when Refraction is down.

entries.name: Tidehunter
lines: Viper Strike cancels out Kraken Shell and stops the hard dispel from passively activating, preventing Tidehunter from functioning as a frontline tank.
Anchor Smash is mostly irrelevant against a ranged hero like Viper.
Tidehunter relies on the threat of Ravage, which has an obscenely long cooldown. Viper can exploit the downtime with his short cooldowns.

entries.name: Vengeful Spirit
lines: Viper Strike can disable the attack damage bonus from Vengeance Aura and the components of Nether Swap.
Both Magic Missile and Wave of Terror are counteracted by Corrosive Skin, making Vengeful Spirit's fighting harder against Viper.

entries.name: Venomancer
lines: Corrosive Skin means Viper can often outlast Venomancer in a battle of attrition.
Venomancer has no mobility without items, which makes him vulnerable to constant slows.

entries.name: Visage
lines: Viper Strike can disable Gravekeeper's Cloak, Visage's primary defense mechanism.
Viper can ignore Grave Chill's attack speed slow with his magic damage output.

entries.name: Zeus
lines: Corrosive Skin severely reduces Zeus's damage output throughout the game.

During the laning stage, Viper can abuse Zeus' reliance on spells by hugging the creep wave. Zeus will take constant damage over time from Corrosive Skin unless he drives Viper from the lane or returns to farming in his absence.
Prior to buying Blink Dagger or Force Staff, Zeus is fragile and possesses low mobility. Any of Viper's numerous slows can set up an easy kill.
Melee heroes with low mobility can be kited and killed by Viper: Treant Protector, Kunkka, Alchemist, Troll Warlord, Wraith King, Tiny, Sven.
Heroes reliant on magical damage cannot easily wear Viper down due to Corrosive Skin.
Any hero that relies on a passives is vulnerable to Viper Strike.
Blink Dagger will continuously be on cooldown with Viper's damage over time spells.

entries.name: Abaddon
lines: The combination of Aphotic Shield and Mist Coil make Viper nearly unkillable after he egresses the laning phase.
The AS/MS slow from Poison Attack sets up Curse of Avernus and vice versa.

entries.name: Beastmaster
lines: Beastmaster by nature expediently pushes towers with maximum points in Inner Beast and Call of the Wild Boar. The aura boosts Viper's DPS while the boars contribute additional slows to assist Poison Attack.
Primal Roar solves Viper's lack of disables that pierce spell immunity.

entries.name: Clockwerk
lines: Hookshot into Power Cogs, combined with Nethertoxin, equals death for many opponents: the magic resistance reduction empowers Battery Assault while Cogs isolate heroes for Viper to focus.
Clockwerk only needs levels to begin rotating for ganks and 1-2 items to significantly contribute to team fights. This ramp-up aligns with Viper's power curve.

entries.name: Crystal Maiden
lines: Arcane Aura grants the necessary mana regeneration for Viper to use Poison Attack in the lane. Unlike Keeper of the Light she does not have to rotate to help him in this regard.
Crystal Maiden is very slow with low health. Viper acts as a distraction with his innate tankiness so she can get off her spells without interruption, especially Freezing Field.

entries.name: Dark Seer
lines: Ion Shell heavily punishes melee opponents that attempt to kill Viper with standard attacks instead of magic damage. It also pushes out the side lanes quickly, a task Viper needs others to perform.
Surge is one of the best abilities to boost Viper's low base movement speed.

entries.name: Dazzle
lines: Poison Touch in practice is an intuitive combination with Poison Attack. Even if the target runs away, it is easy to refresh its duration by throwing out Poison Attack and Nethertoxin. This is particularly strong in the early stages of the game.
Shallow Grave and Shadow Wave can save Viper in dangerous spots while he continues to wear down his opponents.
Bad Juju steadily decreases enemy armor throughout long battles, the type of scuffles Viper excels in.

entries.name: Drow Ranger
lines: Precision Aura greatly increases Viper's attack speed, making his laning phase even stronger.
Gust and Frost Arrows combined with Viper's slows make it difficult for an enemy to escape.
Nethertoxin eliminates the defenses of several heroes that Drow Ranger struggles to kill.
Corrosive Skin makes Viper tanky so he can shield Drow Ranger, who prefers to output damage from the backline.

entries.name: Earth Spirit
lines: Between Boulder Smash, Rolling Boulder and Geomagnetic Grip, the hero is proficient at setting up kills in the midgame. Viper and Earth Spirit become a potent ganking duo that can secure map control.
Earth Spirit is one of the best supports for ganking the midlane. He can secure Viper an advantage before level 5, a period when the hero is traditionally mediocre.
Magnetize contributes strong area-of-effect damage over time, setting up Poison Attack's inverse scaling.
Earth Spirit doesn't need Viper to position himself in a defensive manner; he has such high health that he takes the initiative and willingly barrels into fights.

entries.name: Faceless Void
lines: Chronosphere provides easy targets for Viper to pick off from a distance.
When used in the middle of a team fight, Time Dilation halts the cooldown of disables that are troublesome for Viper to deal with.
Nethertoxin's break mechanic makes many heroes that Faceless Void struggles to kill much easier to take down.
Viper creates space for Faceless Void to farm up lategame items since the former is a potent threat so early in the game.

entries.name: Lich
lines: Frost Shield protects Viper from the majority of damage thrown his way. Additionally, it sets up counterattacks by slowing and damaging nearby enemies.
Sinister Gaze locks fleeing opponents in place, ensuring they can't run away from the slow carry.
Chain Frost is a powerful deterrent against teams that aim to dogpile Viper and kill him before the fight extends too long.
Lich has no escape abilities, making him vulnerable if exposed in team fights. Viper draws attention away from him, enabling Lich to use all his abilities without interruption.

entries.name: Luna
lines: Level 4 Lunar Blessing turns Viper into an intimidating tower pusher when combined with inexpensive items like Dragon Lance, Helm of the Dominator, and Drum of Endurance.
As a hero oriented towards early and midgame battles, Viper makes space on the map for Luna to farm the expensive stats items that make her powerful.
Luna can split-push with Manta Style, ameliorating Viper's lack of movement speed.

entries.name: Necrophos
lines: Heartstopper Aura whittles down enemy health over time, making them more susceptible to Poison Attack.
Death Pulse replenishes Viper's health in small amounts. It can be repeatedly used in fights to save him from certain death.
Like Viper, Necrophos hits his first power peak soon after the laning phase ends.

Necrophos frequently buys items that synergize with Viper's abilities, except they are either obnoxiously expensive or lose effectiveness too quickly to be prudent on the hero itself. These include Radiance, Veil of Discord, and Guardian Greaves.

entries.name: Ogre Magi
lines: Preemptive Bloodlust accelerates Viper's farm, doubly so if he buys Maelstrom.
Ignite as well as Ogre Magi's high base attributes and armor help secure the lane for Viper early on.

entries.name: Slardar
lines: Slithereen Crush interrupts channeling abilities and can lock down a target for Viper to kill.
Corrosive Haze massively increases Viper's single-target damage.
Both Viper and Slardar fight at the same pace. They possess low cooldown spells and the tankiness to use them several times in a fight.

entries.name: Treant Protector
lines: Living Armor protects Viper in lane without the need for rotations. Combined with Corrosive Skin, Viper becomes almost impossible to gank.
Overgrowth locks opponents in place for Viper to attack them.
Viper excels when he is assisted by heals and other means of survival: Pudge, Witch Doctor, Oracle
Viper is a robust tank that can protect fragile ranged heroes with high damage output: Sniper, Dark Willow, Tinker, Weaver
Heroes with magic resistance reduction amplify the power of Nethertoxin and vice versa: Pugna, Skywrath Mage, Elder Titan
Heroes with abilities that increase movement speed compensate for his mobility issues: Dark Seer, Ogre Magi

entries.name: Tango
lines: Tango helps Viper stay in lane.

entries.name: Enchanted Mango
lines: Enchanted Mango provides health regeneration and burst mana.

entries.name: Faerie Fire
lines: Faerie Fire gives attack damage and burst HP.

entries.name: Iron Branch
lines: Iron Branch increases attributes and healing with Tango.

entries.name: Boots of Speed
lines: Boots of Speed are a standard pickup that give movement speed.

entries.name: Wraith Band
lines: Wraith Band provides a decent boost to Viper's attributes. The extra damage and attack speed help him secure last hits.

entries.name: Infused Raindrops
lines: Infused Raindrops adds extra mana regeneration and protection against magical damage.

entries.name: Magic Wand
lines: Magic Wand offers burst health and mana.

entries.name: Arcane Boots
lines: Arcane Boots expand his mana pool, allowing him to use abilities more often inside and outside of combat.

entries.name: Rod of Atos
lines: Rod of Atos gives Viper access to a root, greatly enhancing his ganking power, as well as much-needed stats. The components also provide a convenient build up for him in the early game

entries.name: Guardian Greaves
lines: Guardian Greaves, the upgrade to Arcane Boots, make Viper exceptionally tanky. The active restores a large portion of health and mana to the entire team while dispelling debuffs; the passive prevents low health heroes from succumbing to their wounds. The extra survivability keeps Viper alive far longer, allowing him to sustain his allies and deal more damage.

entries.name: Hurricane Pike
lines: Hurricane Pike enhances his mobility and adds decent stats for reasonable gold.

entries.name: Black King Bar
lines: Black King Bar grants debuff immunity so Viper can act without worrying about most enemy disables.

entries.name: Eye of Skadi
lines: Eye of Skadi is ideal for Viper players who want to frontline. It gives him great stats across the board and the duration of Cold Attack almost perfectly overlaps Poison Attack. The combined attack speed and move speed slows of Viper's abilities and Skadi's modifier will slow any target to a crawl.

entries.name: Monkey King Bar
lines: Monkey King Bar provides magical damage on top of a solid chunk of damage and a little attack speed. It's best suited against enemy carries who are picking up evasion items and heroes with blind.

entries.name: Veil of Discord
lines: Veil of Discord enhances the magical damage of Viper's entire kit as well as granting attributes and armor.

entries.name: Shadow Blade
lines: Shadow Blade is a good pickup on Viper if you intend to seize map control. Viper is a very capable ganker if he can get close to a target. Between both of his slows and his damage scaling up as his target's health decreases, he is very good at 1v1 dueling.

entries.name: Heaven's Halberd
lines: Heaven's Halberd can be an idiosyncratic yet effective choice against teams that rely on damage from 1-2 right-click heroes. Halberd stops those opponents from attacking in addition to granting status resistance and evasion.

entries.name: Sange and Yasha
lines: Sange and Yasha is a common pickup in the midgame. Viper enjoys the additional health and damage, as well as movement speed.

entries.name: Nullifier
lines: Nullifier shuts down heroes who rely on items. Viper by nature struggles against mobility items like Force Staff and Blink Dagger; he is also vulnerable to disables from Orchid Malevolence and Scythe of Vyse. Nullifier also stops targets from activating Black King Bar, Glimmer Cape and other items that counteract his magic damage.

entries.name: Manta Style
lines: Manta Style provides a mix of tankiness, damage, and chasing potential. Mirror Image dispels certain debuffs that cripple Viper's playstyle. Since Corrosive Skin carries over to illusions, it is moderately useful for split-pushing.

entries.name: Mjollnir
lines: Mjollnir is one of the best DPS items for Viper in the lategame. It accentuates his waveclear, adds more magical damage with the active as well as the passive (this damage is greatly amplified under effect of Poison Attack), and provides high attack speed to enhance Poison Attack.Alternatively,if already possessing Rod of Atos, Gleipnir should be considered.

entries.name: Heart of Tarrasque
lines: Heart of Tarrasque increases Viper's tankiness. Combined with Corrosive Skin and Guardian Greaves, Viper becomes incredibly hard to put down.

entries.name: Bloodthorn
lines: Bloodthorn prevents spellcasters from using spells, as well as making your targets more vulnerable to your DPS. The mana regeneration also remedies Viper's constant lack of mana.

entries.name: Octarine Core
lines: Octarine Core combines well with Viper as he can output high magical damage, specifically from Nethertoxin. The spell lifesteal makes this already tanky hero even harder to kill, and stacks with his spell lifesteal talent to provide significant healing. Extra health and mana also allow Viper to live longer and cast more spells during teamfights. Finally, the cooldown reduction allows for more uses of Nethertoxin and Viper Strike, especially when paired with Aghanim's Scepter.

entries.name: Radiance
lines: Radiance is an item to consider on Viper as he is a durable hero who will survive in fight long enough to deal damage over time to his enemies. Combined with spell lifesteal, it adds to his innate tankiness and the damage also allows him to attack enemies with Poison Attack more effectively.

pros: Большой магический урон в ранней игре.
playstyle.text: Viper — опасный герой основы, обычно исполняющий роль центрального героя и, в редких случаях, героя сложной линии. Благодаря своим способностям наносит большой магический урон, однако может при необходимости собрать предметы для физического урона. Все его заклинания направлены на периодический урон с негативными эффектами. Poison Attack является модификатором обычных атак героя, добавляя к ним замедление и урон от яда, а также снижает магическое сопротивление цели. Негативный эффект может накапливаться на цели до 6 раз. Способность делает Viper особенно эффективным против немобильных целей и героев с ближним типом атаки. Nethertoxin создает в указанной области ядовитую лужу, которая наносит урон, повышающийся по мере нахождения в ней. У самого Viper тоже есть пассивный навык — Corrosive Skin, наносит урон всем, кто атакует героя, и снижает их скорость атаки, а также даёт герою сопротивление к магии. Ульт — Viper Strike — крайне сильно замедляет цель, нанося ей магический урон, отключает пассивные способности цели, а также имеет небольшую перезарядку и пробивает невосприимчивость к магии. Способность хорошо работает против героев, чья выживаемость заключена в пассивных способностях вроде Blur или Bristleback.
cons: Относительная слабость в поздней игре по сравнению с другими керри.

lines: Viper can either be played in the off lane with a support, or solo mid.

Viper's main purpose in fights is absorbing enemy attacks while whittling them down with his abilities, allowing the rest of his team to act freely. This is an intentionally loose definition since Viper's talents allow him to emphasize damage output or survivability.
Viper does not need to win the laning stage in order to be a powerhouse in the midgame. In most lane situations, you are better off playing safely rather than exposing yourself to possible ganks.
Viper is one of the slowest heroes in the game. This makes him a progressively weaker and more exploitable target as enemy heroes purchase items such as Force Staff and Blink Dagger.
Poison Attack is Viper's main tool for harassing opponents in lane.
Use Poison Attack to slow down fleeing opponents.
Use Poison Attack in combination with Viper Strike to kite and control melee carries.
Use Poison Attack in combination with Viper Strike to cripple a target's physical DPS.
Keep stacking Poison Attack on the enemies to reduce their magic resistance, causing Viper's and allies' abilities to deal more magical damage.
More tips needed.
Nethertoxin is your primary farming tool.
Nethertoxin's break makes Viper a potent counterpick against many heroes that depend on strong passives.
More tips needed.
Corrosive Skin is the best choice to max first if you and your opponent(s) are trading blows.

Corrosive Skin is especially potent against damage over time abilities, like Scream of Pain or Venomous Gale. Between the magic resistance and continuous reapplication of Corrosive Skin to the enemy caster, Viper will usually take less damage than Corrosive Skin returns.
With enough sustain, Viper should take attacks from creeps to apply Corrosive Skin's damage over time, clearing them faster.
More tips needed.
Viper Strike is one of the best ganking abilities in the early game. Take advantage of it to help teammates win their lanes.
Combine Viper Strike with Nethertoxin to dish out immense damage in the midgame.
With an early Aghanim's Scepter, Viper Strike can be used multiple times in a fight at half the regular mana cost.

notes.text: Перезарядка увеличена с 20 до 25 секунд
Базовый урон за процент отсутствующего здоровья увеличен с 0,15 до 0,25

Aghanim's Scepter теперь также постепенно увеличивает урон и сопротивление магии от этой способности, пока владелец находится в области действия Nethertoxin. Максимальный бонус в 50% достигается спустя 4 секунды.

hero.text: Базовая скорость атаки уменьшена со 120 до 110

bio: В тихом свете Нижних пределов, отрезанных от внешнего мира тектоническим сдвигом, многие миллионы лет обитала раса низших драконов. Один из них, особенно злобный и любопытный, был только рад покинуть опостылевшие пещеры, попавшись в руки наивному магу-изуверу. Змий притворялся верным питомцем колдуна, надеясь постичь его тёмную магию — но вскоре понял, что родная отрава жалит куда злее многих заклинаний. Драконья кислота легко справилась с прутьями клетки. Вырвавшись из заточения, ядовитым плевком ослепил он старого заклинателя и упорхнул на волю, дабы явить миру нового владыку.
trivia: Реплика «Holy shit, it’s me!» — отсылка к сцене из фильма Top Gun.

Китайское имя Viper, 冥界亚龙 (кит. Míngjiè Yàlóng, рус. «Азиатский дракон нижнего мира»), является дословным переводом наименования «Netherdrake». При этом, китайская версия способности Viper Strike использует перевод слова «Viper» (кит. 蝮蛇, fùshé; рус. «Ямочная гадюка»).

notes.text: Дальность применения зависит от дальности атаки героя.
Дальность применения способности может быть увеличена только за счет дополнительной дальности атаки.
И Autocast, и применение вручную используют текущую дальность атаки.
Poison Attack размещает один эффект на цели. Следующие атаки увеличивают счетчик эффектов и сбрасывают его длительность.
Не работает против союзников и вардов.
Число в иконке показывает количество эффектов. Оно видно всем.
Атаки сначала применяют дебафф, затем наносят урон.
С максимальным числом эффектов, Poison Attack уменьшает скорость передвижения цели на 15%/30%/45%/60% (21%/42%/63%/84%).
С усиливающим замедление скорости передвижения талантом, Poison Attack уменьшает скорость передвижения цели на 18%/36%/54%/72% (25,2%/50,4%/75,6%/100,8%).
Ослабление сопротивления магии от Poison Attack сочетается аддитивно само с собой, но мультипликативно с другими источниками манипуляции сопротивлением магии.
С максимальным числом эффектов, Poison Attack снижает сопротивление магии большинства героев до 10%/2,5%/-5%/-12,5% (4%/-6,5%/-17%/-27,5%).
С усиливающим уменьшение сопротивления магии талантом, Poison Attack снижает сопротивление магии большинства героев до -5%/-12,5%/-20%/-27,5% (-17%/-27,5%/-38%/-48,5%).
Наносит урон с интервалом в 1 секунду спустя 1 секунду после применения эффекта, тем самым срабатывая 4 раз за длительность.
С максимальным числом эффектов, Poison Attack наносит 20/40/60/80 (28/56/84/112) урона в секунду и 80/160/240/320 (112/224/336/448) урона суммарно за 4 сек. (до учёта сопротивлений).

С увеличивающим урон в секунду талантом, Poison Attack наносит вражеским существам до 24/48/72/96 (33,6/67,2/100,8/134,4) урона в секунду и 96/192/288/384 (134,4/268,8/403,2/537,6) урона суммарно за 4 сек. (до учёта сопротивлений).
Более детальные расчёты величин наносимого урона и ослабления сопротивления магии приведены в данных таблицах.
Viper может выбирать целью атак постройки, нанося им урон и уменьшая их сопротивление магии и броню.
Уменьшает броню на 1/2/3/4/5/6/7 на всех уровнях.
При максимальном количестве эффектов уменьшает общее сопротивление магии любых задетых построек до -28%/-42%/-56%/-70%.
С учетом уменьшения сопротивления магии, может нанести до 57,34/127,23/209,66/304,64 урона по постройкам.

abilities.lore: Врождённое ядовитое дыхание низших драконов быстро высасывает жизненные силы жертвы.
abilities.description: Добавляет к обычной атаке героя яд, уменьшающий скорость передвижения и сопротивление магии, а также наносящий периодический урон. Эффект яда складывается до 6 раз.
abilities.name: Poison Attack
abilities.shard: Увеличивает максимум эффектов. Каждый эффект уменьшает броню жертвы. Способность действует на постройки, но наносит им меньше урона.

notes.text: Снаряд от Nethertoxin летит со скоростью в 2000 единиц.
Все эффекты Nethertoxin (включая урон) предоставляются аурой. Эффект задерживается на 0,5 сек.
Наносит урон с интервалом в 0,5 секунды спустя 0,5 секунды после получения эффекта, тем самым срабатывая до 14/15/16/17 раз за длительность.
Урон увеличивается на 2,19/3,44/4,69/5,94 каждые 0,5 секунды, проведенные в области, достигая следующих значений за применение.
Так как талант, увеличивающий максимальный и минимальный урон за интервал, усиливает их одинаково на 40, увеличение урона за интервал не меняется.
При достижении значением урона за интервал максимума в 25/37,5/50/62,5 (45/57,5/70/82,5), последующие интервалы наносят максимальный урон до конца времени действия.
Может нанести до 271,25/438,75/631,25/848,75 (551,25/738,75/951,25/1188,75) урона врагам, остававшимся в области всю длительность (до учёта сопротивлений).
Более детальные расчёты величины наносимого урона, включая усиление от увеличивающего урон таланта, приведены в таблице здесь.
Значение урона у врага сбрасывается после покидания области и повторного вхождения. Оно не учитывает непосредственно проведенное в токсине время.
Эффекты от нескольких Nethertoxin не складываются.
При изучении нового уровня способности урон, уже действующий на существ, не обновляется до нового значения.
При этом, если враг получает эффект после поднятия уровня способности, этот враг получит уже новое значение урона.

notes: Эффект от нескольких применений этой способности не складывается.
abilities.lore: Яд нижних пределов делает смертельной каждую рану, каждую немощь.
abilities.description: Герой покрывает землю низшим токсином. Противники в отравленной области получают периодический урон, увеличивающийся со временем пребывания в ней, и медленнее атакуют.
abilities.name: Nethertoxin

notes.text: Складывается по закону убывающей полезности с другими источниками сопротивления магии.
Увеличивает общее сопротивление магии Viper до 33%/36%/40%/44% (29%/31%/33%/34%), учитывая его базовое сопротивление в 25% и не учитывая другие его источники.
С учётом сопротивления магии от этого источника, каждые 10 очков интеллекта увеличивают общее сопротивление магии на 0,9%/0,85%/0,8%/0,75% (0,9%/0,85%/0,8%/0,75%). [?]
Урон и замедление применяются, когда кто-либо наносит урон Viper в радиусе 1400.
Реагирует на все типы урона, но не на урон, нанесённый самому себе или помеченный как "отнимающий здоровье" (например, от Sunder или Sacrifice).
Урон, наносимый способностями, использующими независимые источники урона (например, Proximity Mines, Death Ward), не активирует Corrosive Skin на заклинателя.
Урон от Corrosive Skin относится к неотражаемым способностям, предотвращая взаимодействие урона от него с остальными источниками урона с такой же пометкой.
Также урон от способности игнорируют эффекты, реагирующие на урон.
Наносит урон интервалами в 1 сек. спустя 1 сек. после применения эффекта, тем самым срабатывая 4 раз за длительность.
Наносит до 32/64/96/128 (104/136/168/200) урона (до учёта сопротивлений).
Несколько срабатываний на одну и ту же цель не складываются, но обновляют действие эффекта.
Не действует на постройки, варды, скрытых и союзных существ.
Накладывает эффект на неуязвимых существ, замедляя их скорость атаки, но не нанося урон.
Теперь Corrosive Skin при срабатывании уменьшает скорость атаки на 16/32/48/64 в радиусе 500 вокруг героя.
Corrosive Skin теперь сначала наносит урон, и только затем применяет эффект.
Всё ещё наносит урон в те же интервалы, нанося урон 5 раз(а).
В ближнем радиусе 500, способность в сумме может нанести до 80/160/240/320 (260/340/420/500) урона.
В радиусе 501 ‒ 1400 вокруг героя, способность в сумме может нанести до 40/80/120/160 (130/170/210/250) урона.

notes: Перемножается с другими источниками сопротивления магическому урону.
Истощением отключается обычное срабатывание, но не эффект от применения способности Nosedive.
Урон этой способности считается отражённым. Его нельзя отразить вновь, и от него не срабатывает вампиризм.
abilities.lore: Ржавеющие прямо в руках щиты и мечи — обычное дело для тех, кто посмеет напасть на низшего дракона.
abilities.scepter: Способность накладывает своё замедление атаки, умноженное на 4, на врагов в радиусе 500 от владельца. Урон и сопротивление магии от этой способности постепенно увеличиваются, пока владелец находится в области действия Nethertoxin. Максимальный бонус в 50% достигается спустя 4 сек.
abilities.description: Если враг на расстоянии до 1200 нанесёт герою урон, то отравится заразным ядом, который наносит урон и замедляет атаки. Также способность увеличивает сопротивление магическому урону.
abilities.name: Corrosive Skin

notes.text: Требует Aghanim's Scepter для разблокировки.
При применении способности Viper поднимается на 100 единиц вверх, после чего обрушивается вниз со скоростью 500 за 0,1 сек.
Значения способности Corrosive Skin, применяемой на жертв Nosedive в радиусе действия, удвоены по умолчанию, вне зависимости от расстояния до Viper.
Разрушает деревья в радиусе 100 от точки приземления Viper.
Nosedive сначала применяет бессилие, затем накладывает эффект Corrosive Skin.
Примечания к Corrosive Skin полностью применимы. Если способность не изучена, то Nosedive только наложит бессилие, эффект Corrosive Skin применён не будет.

abilities.lore: Считалось, что низшие драконы опускаются на землю только при смерти, однако некоторые подозревают: свидетелей более нарочных приземлений просто нет в живых.
abilities.description: Герой обрушивается на землю, применяя в точке падения способность Nethertoxin и на 4 сек. накладывая на всех врагов в радиусе 500 эффект Corrosive Skin.
abilities.name: Nosedive

abilities.description: За каждый процент здоровья, отсутствующего у жертвы, атаки героя наносят ей дополнительный физический урон.
abilities.name: Predator

notes.text: Снаряд Viper Strike летит со скоростью в 1500 единиц.
Замедление уменьшается со временем. Пораженным существам возвращается 0,3%/0,4%/0,4% от их скорости передвижения и 0,444/0,667/0,889 от скорости атаки с каждым тиком сервера.
То есть, в секунду возвращается 10%/11,7%/13,3% от скорости передвижения и 13,333/20/26,667 от скорости атаки.
Наносит урон с интервалом в 1 секунду сразу после применения эффекта, тем самым срабатывая 6 раз за длительность.
Наносит до 420/600/900 (900/1080/1380) урона (до учёта сопротивлений).
Несколько применений Viper Strike на одну и ту же цель не складываются, но обновляют длительность эффекта.
Эффекты частиц на крыльях Viper во время анимации применения видны всем, предупреждая об использовании способности.
Полностью действует на курьеров.

abilities.lore: Когда-то жестокого мага погубил самый опасный из ядов его питомца. Теперь же этот яд течёт по венам любого, кто дерзнёт противостоять низшему дракону.
abilities.description: Замедляет скорость атаки и передвижения выбранного врага, при этом нанося ему периодический урон и отключая его пассивные способности. Скорость цели постепенно восстанавливается.
abilities.name: Viper Strike

hype: Ядовитый Viper несёт погибель любой своей жертве. Токсины, которыми он плюётся, ослабляют и замедляют врага, а Viper просто делает то, что умеет лучше всего: продолжает источать яд.
name: Viper
short: Замедляет врагов и разъедает их защиту ядовитыми токсинами
